title: Nahor (son of Serug)
summary: Son of Serug (Gen 11:22); father of Terah and grandfather of Abraham. Not to be confused with Abraham's brother Nahor (Gen 11:26).
description: Masoretic text: born AM 1849 (when his father was the age given in Gen 11), lived 148 years, died AM 1997. No CFAH paper dates this person; the sort year falls to Ussher.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 2155 BC (no higher-tier year available).

birth.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 278 (PDF p. 313)
birth.note: The 15th ed. (2002) Chronological Compendium prints this AM and no BC year. That entry is kept. This BC year is the 23rd ed. Appendix F figure.

birth.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), "Chronological Compendium", p. 1 ("Nahor born when Serug was 30 ... 1849")
Gen 11:10–26 (Arphaxad AM 1658 = Shem's 100th year, two years after the Flood of AM 1656; each later birth adds the father's age at the named son)
Ussher, Annals of the World, Second Age §53 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 2)," Biblical Chronology 6:4 (April 1994), §8 "The Chronology of Genesis 11" (year list)
Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 2, chart "Genesis 11:10 – 12 Genealogy"
birth.note: Agrees with Jordan's own published AM 1849.

birth.date: "Nahor was born to Serug in his hundred and thirty-second year"
birth.note: Josephus (Whiston) has 132; the Masoretic text has 30 (Gen 11:22).

birth.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 782a
birth.note: Year cell "2532 1850 193". The third printed figure 193 is the column "Floud", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 148 at the end of the name is the lifespan he prints. His table also prints the death at World 1997. 1850 + 148 is not 1997. Both figures are left as printed.

birth.citation: Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology and Geography, History and Prophecy, 2nd ed., corrected and improved (London: C. J. G. & F. Rivington, 1830), vol. II, Synopsis of the Chronology, p. xxxiii
birth.note: The parenthesis is the Hebrew age. The other age is the one he adopts. The last figure is his B.C. column. This is Nahor son of Serug.

death.note: Not stated in the Jones sources read (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament 15th ed. 2002). Leave empty until verified.

death.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Second Age §61 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
